description: Upload a ZIP file to update an existing Chrome Web Store item draft. Note: Creating new items via API is not supported in v2 — use the Developer Dashboard to create new items.

itemId.description: Extension item ID (defaults to CWS_ITEM_ID env var)

publisherId.description: Publisher ID (defaults to CWS_PUBLISHER_ID env var or 'me')

zipPath.description: Absolute path to the ZIP file to upload

name: upload
